svg.title: The near rangeland: the pasture plane, a two-track ranch road on the ground polyline, tussocks, wild rose and buckbrush, three cattle grazing at the grass horizon, and a wire fence on wooden posts whose rhythm is what makes movement legible at a horse's speed. World y 880..1290; TRANSPARENT above world 1130 - the fence posts and the wire stand up into the sky - and opaque below it. Every object on this tile is a TYPE: it repeats every 1920 px, so it may not carry anything that identifies a place, and the cattle and the fence are drawn from refs/alberta-foothills/rangeland-cattle-and-wire-fence.jpg and log-rail-fence.jpg as the types they are.
